name: Plan Task-triggered Project Director orchestration
description: Create and validate a new managed implementation plan from TRD-20260902-C2F3AF2B for future source-only revisions of reusable Task and Project Director orchestration assets, while preserving active project copies and not executing the plan.
definition_of_done: The source TRD is inspected as a readable nonsymlink file and its identifier, revision, lifecycle state, and SHA-256 digest are captured in the managed plan.

A new managed plan is created through the to-implementation-plan helper and maps all 23 TRD requirements, explicit exclusions, recorded decisions, and open question Q01 to bounded phases and tasks with bidirectional coverage.
The plan remains draft while material readiness gates are unresolved, and helper show and validate operations confirm its canonical state, deterministic projections, and catalog entry.

No planned implementation, reusable-asset adoption, dependency installation, Git mutation, publication, deployment, external communication, destructive action, or modification of protected active copies occurs.
current_summary: Planning Task completed. Managed plan PLAN-20260902-2C15FED4 is draft revision 3 with 23 requirements, 8 decisions, one open question, 5 phases, and 16 planned tasks. Canonical structure, coverage, projections, and catalog state are current; validation remains unresolved only for Q-001. No implementation or adoption occurred.
